title: Intent
description: Immutable declaration of the action an Authority intends to be executed under an Authorization.

authorizationId.description: Authorization under which this Intent was created. Must match authorization.authorizationId. Parmana rejects a mismatch with a 400.

action.description: Business action being requested. Required and non-empty. Parmana rejects an empty action with a 400.

parameters.description: Immutable business parameters describing the intended action. Not evaluated by policy, see signals.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Intent was created.
